name: McKenzie
summary: McKenzie, who says she's 'from SA' (likely Seeking Arrangement) and lives near Jacksonville, FL, reached out seeking a sugar/allowance arrangement. The owner didn't initially recognize her, expressed distrust (said she previously lied about being in the emergency room), and set terms: he would only pay cash if she came to him, and he refused to book her a flight. She persisted with offers of a long-term arrangement and explicit content; he declined, saying he already has an arrangement and no time for it. Not a business client.
key_facts: Met via 'SA' (likely Seeking Arrangement); not a business contact
Lives near Jacksonville (JAX), not Miami; previously visited but they never met
Owner distrusts her over a prior emergency-room lie; refused to book a flight
Owner's only terms: she travels to him, cash payment, then consider an arrangement
Owner declined as of 2026-10-23, says he already has an arrangement
